cases.explain: «Молодые слуги» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben Hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, “Men are coming out from Samaria.”

cases.sentence: ___ наместников провинций и израильское войско, которое шло за ними, вышли из города.
cases.explain: «Молодые слуги» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: So these went out of the city, the young men of the princes of the provinces, and the army which followed them.

cases.sentence: Каждый сразил своего противника, арамеи бежали, и Израиль преследовал их, но царь Арама Венадад спасся на коне вместе с ___.
cases.explain: «другими всадниками» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: They each killed his man. The Syrians fled, and Israel pursued them. Ben Hadad the king of Syria escaped on a horse with horsemen.

cases.sentence: Сделай вот что: убери всех царей с их мест в войске и замени ___.
cases.explain: «другими военачальниками» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Do this thing: take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their place.

cases.sentence: ___ Венадад собрал арамеев и пошел к Афеку, чтобы сразиться с Израилем.
cases.explain: «Следующей весной» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: At the return of the year, Ben Hadad mustered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.

cases.sentence: Семь дней стояли они друг напротив друга, и на ___ разгорелась битва.
cases.explain: «седьмой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: They encamped opposite each other for seven days. So it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined; and the children of Israel killed one hundred thousand footmen of the Syrians in one day.

cases.sentence: Израильтяне нанесли арамеям потери в сто тысяч ___ за один день.
cases.explain: «пеших воинов» — after the preposition «в», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: They encamped opposite each other for seven days. So it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined; and the children of Israel killed one hundred thousand footmen of the Syrians in one day.

cases.explain: «другого человека» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Then he found another man, and said, “Please strike me.” The man struck him and wounded him.
